project.description: 刷新 cyt-common-deploy 的 BRANCH 下拉列表 = GitHub 当前分支。新建分支后点一下即可，零插件、不重启 Jenkins。

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail TOKEN=$(cat /opt/jenkins/github_token_common) REPO="https://wangzi-prince:${TOKEN}@github.com/wangzi-prince/CYT-Common.git" PROXY=http://172.18.0.6:7890 WORK=/tmp/cyt-common-refresh-$$ trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
if ! env GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_HTTP_LOW_SPEED_LIMIT=1000 GIT_HTTP_LOW_SPEED_TIME=20 \ git clone --depth 1 --branch main "$REPO" "$WORK"; then echo "==> 直连 GitHub 失败，改走代理 $PROXY 重试" rm -rf "$WORK" env GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 HTTP_PROXY="$PROXY" HTTPS_PROXY="$PROXY" \ git clone --depth 1 --branch main "$REPO" "$WORK" fi cd "$WORK" bash deploy/test-server/refresh-branches.sh main
